strengths: Clean modular runner separation (openapi-schemas, codegen-compile, payload-size, spectral) with a shared RunnerResult shape
Dependency-injectable Docker check (checkDocker option) makes the 'no silent pass' behavior deterministically testable without a live Docker daemon
Temp workdirs are always cleaned up in finally blocks (codegen-compile.ts:133-135, spectral.ts:61-63)
Dockerfile is genuinely multi-arch (TARGETARCH -> x86_64/aarch64) and uses debian-slim + xtensa-esp-elf toolchain, not the full ESP-IDF image, matching spec §Codegen-compile pipeline
Explicit error propagation on Docker unavailable and on docker run/pull failure — satisfies the [CRITICAL] no-silent-pass constraint
cJSON.h vendored verbatim (v1.7.19) and copied into the image; hashtable.h/list.h syntax-only stubs added so quicktype cjson output type-checks

issues.description: Dead variable: `generatedPath` is assigned `outBase` but never used; the docker invocation builds the path inline as `/work/${topLevel}`.

The end-to-end quicktype->xtensa gcc test is conditionally skipped when Docker is unavailable (falls back to asserting the 'Docker unavailable' path), so the real codegen+compile pipeline is only exercised in Docker-capable environments; spectral.ts has no accompanying test.
